name: The Lord of Blackrock
summary: This quest marks the final delivery of Rend Blackhand's severed head to the leaders of Orgrimmar. Having proven the false Warchief's demise to Eitrigg, champions are directed to Overlord Natoj in the Valley of Strength to display the trophy before the entire Horde.

sections.title: A Trophy for the Horde
sections.body: After the Dark Horde warlord Rend Blackhand is executed within the upper reaches of Blackrock Spire, his head is brought to Orgrimmar as proof of his defeat. Veteran warrior Eitrigg confirms the fall of his former ruler before sending the victor to Overlord Natoj in the Valley of Strength. There, the gruesome remains are prepared to be displayed publicly, serving as a warning to enemies and a rallying cry for the true Horde.

sections.title: Claiming the Legacy
sections.body: Rend Blackhand claimed leadership over the true legacy of the Orcish Horde, clinging to the demonic shadow of the Blackrock clan within the burning mountain. By striking him down and hoisting his head high over the gates of Orgrimmar, Warchief Thrall's Horde dismantles the remnants of the Old Horde's corrupt leadership once and for all.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: It serves as the concluding turn-in for slaying Rend Blackhand. After showing proof to Eitrigg, you report to Overlord Natoj in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength to receive honors and have the severed head put on public display.
Overlord Natoj is an officer of the Horde stationed in the Valley of Strength within Orgrimmar, responsible for receiving major military trophies and granting recognition to Horde champions.

faq.q: Why is Rend Blackhand's head put on display?
faq.answer: Mounting the head of the false Warchief proves beyond doubt that the Dark Horde's leadership has crumbled. It strengthens the morale of Orgrimmar's defenders and demonstrates Thrall's supreme authority over the orcs.

Rend Blackhand was the son of the former Warchief Blackhand. He styled himself Warchief of the Dark Horde, ruling over renegade orcs, trolls, and ogres entrenched inside Upper Blackrock Spire in defiance of Thrall.
Natoj stands on watch in the Valley of Strength, the central entrance district of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What role does Eitrigg play in this?
faq.answer: Eitrigg was once an honorable warrior of the Blackrock clan who abandoned Rend due to his corruption. Verifying Rend's death with Eitrigg brings closure to the veteran before the trophy is officially mounted by Natoj.

angles.text: The public display of Rend Blackhand's head reinforces Thrall's new order and proves the superiority of the reformed Horde over the corrupt factions of the past.
For orcs, witnessing the defeat of the Blackhand line provides deep catharsis, cleansing the dishonorable shadow cast by the Old Horde's warmongering leadership.
